```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
clean_data <- read_csv("/Users/chihhsuan/Desktop/UBC 26W/SOCI 502/SOCI502_data_story/data/clean_data.csv")
```

```{r}
glimpse(clean_data)
```

```{r}
head(clean_data)      
tail(clean_data)       
```

```{r}
table(clean_data$sex)
table(clean_data$age)
table(clean_data$edu)
table(clean_data$birth)
table(clean_data$country)
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(clean_data$unemp_rate))          # 缺值筆數
mean(is.na(clean_data$unemp_rate)) * 100   # 缺值比例（%）
```

```{r}
clean_data |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            n_missing = sum(is.na(unemp_rate))) |>
  filter(n_missing > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(n_missing))
```

```{r}
clean_data |>
  filter(sex == "female") |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            n_missing = sum(is.na(unemp_rate))) |>
  filter(n_missing > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(n_missing))
```
